title: Middle East crisis live: Iran denies Trump’s claims that talks due to take place
summary_full: Iranian spokesperson says there are no plans to receive or send a delegation following US president’s assertion that talks would take place on MondayIran in talks with Oman over shipping route but not US, says TehranCrude oil prices fell sharply and European stock markets rallied on Monday after Donald Trump cancelled planned strikes on Iran to focus on negotiations for a peace deal.Brent crude was trading 5% lower at $83.50 a barrel by mid-morning, after falling as low as $81.55 a barrel.
